create_HabitatLogger_with_file: create a HabitatLogger instance that writes log messages to a specified file with a custom format string
create_HabitatLogger_with_stream: create a HabitatLogger instance that writes log messages to stdout using a StreamHandler
add_filehandler_to_logger: add an additional FileHandler to an existing HabitatLogger instance for writing logs to a new file
configure_logger_level_via_env: configure the default habitat logger level by setting the HABITAT_LAB_LOG environment variable
use_default_habitat_logger: use the pre-configured habitat module-level logger to log messages with timestamp formatting
